summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of KrishiLink modular refactor across all 10 workspace pages, topbar menus, and mobile viewport. All requested features tested end-to-end; zero window.prompt/alert/confirm remain; no console/page errors captured. All primary data-testid selectors resolve. Charts (recharts) render on Market Prices. Modal forms with validation exist on Produce, Storage, Transport, Marketplace, Prices, and Profile.
critical_code_review_comments: Requests.jsx opens the offer modal with reply.price pre-filled from the request price. As a result, the acceptance test expectation 'send-offer-button with empty price shows validation' does not trigger unless the user manually clears the field. Validation logic itself works correctly when price is empty/<=0. Consider either (a) initializing reply.price to '' on open, or (b) updating the acceptance test to expect a prefilled value. Not a functional bug.
AppStore is entirely in-memory (no persistence) as documented; page reloads reset added produce/listings/trips/orders/alerts. Confirmed intentional per problem statement.

Modal backdrop from prior open modal can intercept pointer events on next navigation if not closed via testId; would benefit from a top-level Escape handler already present but ensure route change also closes modal (minor).
seed_data_creation: None (all data is mock in-memory in AppStore)
